At the 2024 Seoul Debates on "Leveraging Innovation for Sustainable and Low-Carbon Energy," I had the opportunity to moderate a disruptive conversation. The event featured welcoming words from Dr. Anne Juepner Director of UNDP Seoul Policy Centre H.E. Insun Kang, 2nd Vice Minister of Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Republic of Korea and Mr. Achim Steiner UNDP Administrator—all highlighting the crucial need for collective and truly innovative solutions to our world’s climate challenges.

Sharing the stage with esteemed panelists—Mr. Seunghyo Choi from Korea's Ministry of Trade, Industry, and Energy; Ms. Gothami Gannoruwa from Sri Lanka's Ministry of Power and Energy; Ms. Kim Hee of POSCO Holdings; and Dr. Semee Yoon from @‌Seoul National University—we delved into how digitalization and innovation can transform the sustainable energy landscape. The discussions covered policy incentives, impacts on rural energy access, private sector innovations in energy efficiency, and academia's role in bridging technology and policy.

In my opening remarks, I emphasized three key points: the transformative convergence of the data revolution with renewable energy, the imperative of embedding innovation into the very fabric of our sustainable energy systems, and the advancement of inclusive technologies to bridge innovation gaps. ⚡️
